pendant.name: Arcana Pendant
pendant.description: A crystalline pendant that protects you from the unmaking and collects Arcana from defeated enemies.

dragonscaleArmor.name: Dragonscale Armor
dragonscaleArmor.description: Armor crafted from the scales of ancient dragons. Provides excellent protection.

flamebrandSword.name: Flamebrand Sword
flamebrandSword.description: A sword imbued with the essence of fire. Burns enemies on contact.

arcanaElixir.name: Arcana Elixir
arcanaElixir.description: Increases Arcana gained from enemies for {{duration}} seconds.

dragonScale.name: Dragon Scale
dragonScale.description: A sturdy scale shed by a dragon. Used in crafting armor.

arcanaCrystal.name: Arcana Crystal
arcanaCrystal.description: A crystallized form of pure Arcana. Used in enchantments.

emberStone.name: Ember Stone
emberStone.description: A stone that radiates heat. Used in fire-based crafting.

ancientScroll.name: Ancient Scroll
ancientScroll.description: A scroll containing knowledge from before the Rift.

barr ierFragment.name: Barrier Fragment
barr ierFragment.description: A piece of the Barrier's crystalline structure. Perhaps it can be studied.
